viewport-organization.copy: Organize Checkbox rows by available reading space: stack on narrow screens, align with tables on wide screens, and avoid dense clusters on touch surfaces.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use full-width rows with large density.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Stack short groups before moving into two-column layouts.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Align with table rows or permission columns, keeping labels readable.
